arcs.title: Above Marker 9
arcs.summary: Day 1: Mira Ashworth mentioned, before leaving, an unmarked spur above survey Marker 9 — four hundred yards northeast of the Keeps Ridge crossing, not on any chart, climbing into unmapped ground. She has walked its first hundred yards. She did not say more. Steve has found the edge of the chart where the spur would begin. A preliminary expedition file has been opened. Day 2 should deepen the mystery of the spur: perhaps a detail from Ashworth's second contact (a follow-up owl, or a rough sketch she left behind), or a first attempt to locate the spur's mouth on the ground — a Saturday drive up the corridor, a glimpse of the turnoff, something that suggests the line is real and worth running.
